description:

The fields and their values are:
-   **Name:** ES616_roads
-   **Country:** Spain/España
-   **Region:** Jaén
-   **Reference Year:** -
-   **Time Range of Extracted Data:** - (with a help icon)
-   **INSPIRE Themes:** - (with an external link icon)
-   **Resolution:** 10 m
-   **Created By:** CLC+ Core User Admin/Support (hyperlinked)
-   **Organisation/s:** CLC (hyperlinked), European Environment Agency (EEA) (hyperlinked)
-   **Contact Person:** -
